001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
004import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.PinDao;
005import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
006import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
007import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Completable;
008import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Scheduler;
009import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single;
010import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers;
011import java.time.Instant;
012import java.util.List;
013import javax.inject.Inject;
014import javax.inject.Singleton;
015
016@Singleton
017public class PinRepository {
018
019  private final PinDao pinDao;
020  private final Scheduler scheduler;
021  private final GoogleSignInService googleSignInService;
022
023  @Inject
024  PinRepository(PinDao pinDao, GoogleSignInService googleSignInService) {
025    this.pinDao = pinDao;
026    this.googleSignInService = googleSignInService;
027    scheduler = Schedulers.io();
028  }
029
030  public Single<Pin> save(Pin pin) {
031    return (pin.getId() != 0)
032      ? Completable.fromAction(() -> pin.setModifiedOn(Instant.now()))
033        .andThen(pinDao.update(pin))
034        .toSingle(() -> pin)
035        .subscribeOn(scheduler)
036      : pinDao
037        .insertAndReturn(pin)
038        .subscribeOn(scheduler);
039  }
040
041  public LiveData<Pin> get(long id) {
042    return pinDao.selectById(id);
043  }
044
045  public Completable remove(Pin pin) {
046    return pinDao
047        .delete(pin)
048        .subscribeOn(scheduler);
049  }
050
051  public LiveData<List<Pin>> getAll(User user) {
052    return pinDao.selectByCreatedOnAsc(user.getId());
053  }
054
055  public LiveData<List<Pin>> getAllForUser(User user) {
056    return pinDao.selectByUserId(user.getId());
057  }
058
059}
